scopes.name: dev
scopes.note: rg defaults: respects .gitignore, skips hidden and binary files. rg's best case.

scopes.name: all
scopes.note: Everything on disk under the root (node_modules, bin/obj, hidden). What 'search my whole machine' means. Minutes per query, so fewer runs and queries.

queries.note: No matches. Worst case for a scanner (reads everything), best case for an index.

rg.note: Baseline. Scans files at query time. Names mode: lists every file (-uu) and keeps those whose name matches.

mtseek.note: The tool we are building. Content modes: rg-compatible flags. Names mode: its cache is emptied before each cell, so `first` is a cold index build and the timed runs reuse the saved index.

mtseek-index.note: mtseek through its content index (M2). The index is emptied before each cell, so `first` includes building it; the timed runs search the saved index without opening a user file.

csearch.note: Russ Cox codesearch. Run `cindex <root>` first; searches whatever was indexed. Adapter untested.
